propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit ticket via git blame on the pre-fix state, if a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines across file_impact point to one commit that resolves to a ticket via rebar-ticket: trailer.
Add --caused-by <id> parameter to rebar transition command to explicitly override or augment auto-derived caused_by links at close time.
The auto-link must write via _write_link_event directly after the bug is closed, bypassing the closed-source guard that would otherwise reject links from closed sources.
If no fixing commit resolves to the bug ticket, no file_impact is recorded, no >50% dominant commit exists, or no resolvable trailer is found, auto-derivation returns None and no link is drawn.

Thread caused_by parameter end-to-end through transition CLI (_parse_flags, transition_compute) and the public library facade (transition() in _lib_writes.py) so both CLI and library callers can set it.
